body:
Hi @godotnerdo , it's a bit unclear from your project what your actual setup is. For System information, you put down Windows, but you mention in Issue description that you are trying to use an M4 Mac Mini. Could you use the "Help > Copy System Info" menu option within Godot on the device you are using to try and export the iOS app? 

Can you also try making sure that the Xcode command line tools are installed? You should be able to install them if they aren't using `xcode-select --install` in your terminal.

A Minimal reproduction project (MRP) is the simplest project you can create where the issue still occurs. For instance, if you create a blank project and this issue still occurs, that would be an MRP for this issue. If it doesn't, then you would try to isolate specific aspects of the project you are encountering the issue on to see what is causing it to happen. Once you know approximately what that is, you can create a simple project with just the problematic parts that contributors can use for debugging and testing fixes.

Hi, you're right my apologies, I am creating my game on a windows pc but I am sending it to my mac mini m4 that I bought specifically to export to ios.  
I did try to install xcode-select --install and it installed but I still got the error, I used mac os tahoe 26.
and I just tried to export a new file and it worked but my app file doesn't.
my app file does use plugins called "geolocationplugin" "locationios" and "praxismappergpsplugin" for android
and I tried disabling each addon individually and exporting, and I even tried disabling all addons and exporting but I still get the same error. but I will say, it at least asks me for signature password when I disable praxismapper and locationios addon

Had the same issue when exporting to iOS on my mac mini m4 (i think its unrelated to the machine though), turned out it was the "&" in the project name, had to rename and ensure the following:

1. Project Settings -> Advanced Settings -> Dotnet -> Project -> Assebly Name was set correctly.
2. Xcode was updated and terms and conditions were accepted. 
3. Had to set up the The Code Sign Identity Release / Debug to Apple Development and Get the App Store Team ID From the personal development keychain certificate

That sorted it. Hope this helps

Thank you for your response, my issue wasn't the project name but your response inspired me to try one more time, and it turns out my export_preset was enabling a plugin that was causing issues, all I did was disable it and it exported to xcode, and then I just archived the project on xcode and published it to testflight
I fixed it by setting export method release to Development and Code Sign Identity Release to Apple Development
